svg.title: For each regulator parameter, retain the actual finite-basis coordinates of every moving label. The source section fixes these coordinates, so every finite even-moment expansion, with all scalar coefficients and conjugates, is identical before taking limits. Coefficient products and fixed-label correlations converge on the same refining filter. Its continuum replica expression and subsequent large-displacement limit therefore recover the same ground-algebra moments. In the commutative algebra the resulting norm test is Z
